purpose: CUTOFF-retained state typicality only; not G2 admission, action-only-shift proof or BCA efficacy
seed_check_scope: No literal matches in current candidate/v3/definition sources; full derived-seed collision and independent stream checks required before sealing any executable.

criteria.distance: standardized Euclidean to retained fitting rows; leave own episode out of reference queries
criteria.invalid_or_insufficient: INCONCLUSIVE, stop; no sample top-up, band change, radius change or threshold change
criteria.pass: Retained-state typicality supported on these independent development samples only; no conditional-action density or equality-of-state-distribution claim

size_rationale.assumptions: Episode-independent mixture/action streams and existing independent split; all deep episodes stay at high load. Worlds are paired, not independent replications. Only controls minimum group counts, not probability of passing distances.

data_policy: Preserve recorder/physics/mask; persist full arrays, group IDs, CUTOFF masks and query state/time identities; one fixed fresh development attempt. No selection or final-calibration fitting/access for decision. Existing consumed data remains development.
